primitives.name: Tiered Quality Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Quality is a system, not a hope:** tiered gates with numeric rubrics (Section 1).
primitives.assumptions: Each tier has fixed rubric weights and pass thresholds; Q is computed as a normalized dot product of R and observed dimensions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When Q < threshold(T), piece fails and does not ship.

layer2.mapping: GSE's production engine computes Q from format-specific rubrics; GSI infers quality confidence via Bayesian updating on verified vs designed values.
layer2.telemetry: Observed pass/fail flags, rubric scores, and final shipping status.

primitives.name: Uniqueness Inventory Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Uniqueness is a gate:** no piece is produced without a named one-of-a-kind element (Section 4, U2 inventory).
primitives.assumptions: Every content piece must reference a unique item from U2 inventory; S = true implies U > 0.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If S = false, content is rejected pre-production.

layer2.mapping: GSE's uniqueness engine maps I to U; GSI tracks U as a categorical feature in content classification models.
layer2.telemetry: Inventory item IDs, uniqueness validation flags, and content publication status.

primitives.name: Consistency Structure
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Consistency is structure:** templates, cadence, naming, versioning, asset library, measurement ledger, weekly review (Sections 1–2).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C': 'consistency index (dimensionless)', 'T': 'template adherence (boolean)', 'M': 'measurement ledger entry (scalar)', 'W': 'weekly review cycle (integer)'}
primitives.assumptions: C is a function of T, M, and W; higher C correlates with stable output volume and quality.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If T = false, C drops below threshold and triggers rework.

layer2.mapping: GSE enforces C via template and measurement systems; GSI monitors C as a proxy for operational stability.
layer2.telemetry: Template compliance logs, measurement ledger entries, and weekly review summaries.
